why: owner 26 Nov: the 1.1.6-beta DRAFT again (preview red pulse, taint names) - not published

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.1.6-beta for WoW Forever 1.60.1

New: settings window v4 (simpler and exact)
- One control per real thing: NPC names (Persian / Persian + English under it / English), zone names (map, zone text and dungeons together), spell name and spell description (one choice each, the tooltip follows), quest parts, talk, system lines.
- Removed the rows that did nothing or did the same as another row (the General 'default display for every section' rows, the module on/off rows on the pages, the item-only preset). Module state stays on the Status page.
- Talents follow the spells; 'Talents on their own' shows their own two rows only when you want them.
- The talk and system-line switches: turning one on while the main switch is off turns on only that one.
- Short labels, no long notes.

New: a live preview in the settings window
- A column on the left and an eye button only next to settings that change something you can see: zone text, map label, NPC tooltip, quest tracker and quest window, a REAL spell tooltip (spellbook or talents), NPC gossip and talk, chat, system lines, red alerts, the game's windows, the game font, and a quest sentence with names and terms.
- The exact part a setting changes blinks red in the sample (the word, the title, the objectives or the pane).
- Switch a setting and the sample changes at once; the English original is shown under it.

New: the game's own windows in Persian
- The game menu, character (stats, reputation, skills, honour), bags and bank, the spellbook tabs, friends / who / guild / raid, mail, trade, merchant, auction house, trainers, loot and the group finder: about 430 texts.
- Switch: General > the game's windows (on by default). Off puts every English text back at once.
- Secure buttons are never touched and nothing changes during combat.

Fixed
- Fewer 'Interface action blocked' lines: the addon no longer calls the game's own quest tracker, nameplate or window-panel functions. If the game still blocks an action bar, the report line now names the exact variable the addon touched.
- English texts in a game window could turn small: they get the game's own font and size back now.
- Bestial Wrath: 'fear' is the feeling there, not the spell Fear.
- The 'Story' preset keeps the game words (damage, pet, health) Persian.
- Profession recipe tooltips (Reagents, Equip, Use, the made item) are no longer counted as missing translations: items stay English for now.
- Switching NPC names off puts the English target-frame and nameplate name back at once.

New Persian
- 73 NPC talk lines that many NPCs share (trainers, flight masters, vendors, festivals).
